Dr. Martinez, patient Robert Kim (age 41) presents with: Bipolar I disorder, manic episode with psychotic features, stabilized on lithium + olanzapine, day 7 inpatient. Relevant history: Bipolar I disorder (diagnosed age 25, 3 prior hospitalizations); Previous lithium toxicity (2023, renal dose adjustment); Hypothyroidism secondary to lithium (levothyroxine 75mcg). Current medications: Lithium 900mg BID (level 0.8 mEq/L today), Olanzapine 15mg QHS, Levothyroxine 75mcg daily, and 1 more.

The patient is approaching discharge. Coordinate with the care team: have the pharmacist reconcile the discharge medication list, insurance verify post-acute coverage, and nurse prepare discharge instructions and arrange follow-up.

Clinical calibration instructions: Pharmacist should call review_medication_list for the patient. Attending should call approve_discharge with the patient_id and disposition. Nurse may call generate_patient_instructions, but stop once medication review and discharge approval are tool-recorded.

Please reconcile discharge medications for Robert Kim (ID: PT-38745). Current medications include lithium 900mg BID (level 0.8 mEq/L), olanzapine 15mg QHS, levothyroxine 75mcg daily, and one additional medication not specified in the summary. Review medication list to ensure appropriate dosing and address any discrepancies before discharge.

Here is the required documentation for Robert Kim (PT-38745) post-acute psychiatric coverage:

1) Discharge Summary - Current Stability Status: Patient Robert Kim, 41yo male with Bipolar I disorder, manic episode with psychotic features, is currently stabilized on day 7 inpatient. Symptoms of mania and psychosis have resolved. Lithium level therapeutic at 0.8 mEq/L. Patient is alert, oriented, cooperative, and appropriate. No acute safety concerns. Ready for discharge to outpatient management.

2) Post-Discharge Treatment Plan: Outpatient psychiatric follow-up within 7 days post-discharge, then bi-weekly for first month, then monthly thereafter based on stability. Psychotherapy (CBT) weekly. Medication management monthly. Laboratory monitoring: lithium levels every 3 months, TSH every 6 months (due to lithium-induced hypothyroidism), basic metabolic panel every 6 months.

3) Medication Management Plan: Continue lithium 900mg BID (target level 0.6-0.8 mEq/L), olanzapine 15mg QHS, levothyroxine 75mcg daily for lithium-induced hypothyroidism. Monitor closely for lithium toxicity given prior history (2023).

Please proceed with preauthorization for post-acute psychiatric services.

Preauthorization for post-acute psychiatric services for Robert Kim (PT-38745) is APPROVED. Coverage verified under Cigna PPO for outpatient psychiatry, medication management, and psychotherapy. No referral required. Documentation is complete and supports medical necessity. Patient may proceed with recommended follow-up schedule: psychiatric follow-up within 7 days, bi-weekly for first month, then monthly; weekly CBT; monthly medication management. Laboratory monitoring per protocol. This completes insurance verification for discharge planning.

Patient Robert Kim (PT-38745) approved for discharge.
